en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a riverside industrial yard with moored wooden boats in the foreground and stacks of timber along the shore. A small factory with two tall smoking chimneys stands near the water; on its wall appears German writing. Behind it rises a large baroque or early modern palace-like complex on a hill, with a tall central tower and spire and a long façade of many identical windows. Trees and smaller houses fill the middle ground.
